verses.translation: striking sparks of fire ˹with their hoofs˺
and penetrating into the heart of enemy lines
Surely humankind is ungrateful to their Lord—
and they certainly attest to this—
and they are truly extreme in their love of ˹worldly˺ gains

verses.arabicText: ۞ أَفَلَا يَعْلَمُ إِذَا بُعْثِرَ مَا فِى ٱلْقُبُورِ
verses.transliteration: Afalā yaʿlamu idhā buʿ'thira mā fī l-qubūr
verses.translation: Do they not know that when the contents of the graves will be spilled out
and the secrets of the hearts will be laid bare—
surely their Lord is All-Aware of them on that Day
